anomalies.observed: On sheet 1, both ADM3260 isolators (U2 for pH, U6 for EC) have their isolated-side I2C pins (SDA1/SCL1 = pins 18/19, adjacent to VISO/GNDISO/VDDISO) and their non-isolated primary-side I2C pins (SDA2/SCL2 = pins 3/2, adjacent to GNDp/VDDp/PDIS) labelled with the SAME global net names NET0028 (SDA) and NET0007 (SCL) that are used for the main ESP32 I2C bus and the unisolated RTD (M2). The EZO-pH (M6) and EZO-EC (M5) signal lines therefore sit on NET0028/NET0007 on the isolated side as well.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, each EZO channel must sit on its own isolated-domain I2C pair (/SDA_pH, /SCL_pH via U3; /SDA_EC, /SCL_EC via U4) that is galvanically separate from the main non-isolated I2C bus; the two sides of the ADM3260 must not share net names, otherwise the 2.5 kV barrier is bypassed.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, I2C SENSORS: U2 ADM3260 pins 18,19 labelled NET0028/NET0007 and pins 3,2 labelled NET0028/NET0007; U6 ADM3260 pins 18,19 labelled NET0028/NET0007 and pins 3,2 labelled NET0028/NET0007

U3 (pH) and U4 (EC) each present a secondary isolated I2C pair (/SDA_pH/SCL_pH, /SDA_EC/SCL_EC) ... each with its own isolated supply/ground domain generated on-chip ... galvanically separate from the main +3V3/+5V/+24V domains.

anomalies.impact: The identical net labels merge the isolated pH/EC I2C domains with the non-isolated digital I2C bus, defeating the ADM3260 galvanic isolation. The EZO modules are powered from the isolated VISO/GNDISO rails but their SDA/SCL return through the main ground, shorting the isolated ground domain to the digital ground and reintroducing exactly the ground-loop/noise/PE-coupling path the isolators were added to break; readings become unreliable and the 2.5 kV safety barrier is lost.

parsed.summary: The power train, TMC2209 pump drivers, MOSFET switches and DNP optional sensors match the specification, but both ADM3260 I2C isolators (U2, U6) have their isolated-side and primary-side I2C pins tied to the same net names (NET0028/NET0007) as the main bus, bridging the galvanic isolation barrier that the design intends for the pH/EC probes.
